about: The tier change on a full desk (desk/stage.ts, shell/tier.ts, desk/layout.ts, render/useModel.ts): each of its fixes switched off by one small change to its source (vite.config.ts HS_SWITCH, test build only); each must make a guard of acceptance/tier.json fail (tools/behaviour/switches.mjs --package '^tier$'). A switch here brings a cost back without changing what the page shows at rest, so only the guards can catch it.

switches.feature: tier: a return to a tier draws only what is in view
tier: a tile's models do not depend on the desk's tier
tier: the held tiles are drawn once the motion has started
tier: the desk is laid out once a change, after the parts' effects
tier: the desk is measured without a class on it
